expectations.text: A valid .docx file exists in outputs/ that python-docx can open and that contains at least one table
expectations.evidence: CPAS.2026_EGC_summary_report_2026-07-24.docx opens with python-docx; 28 paragraphs, 2 tables (overview + daily).

expectations.text: The report states 9 flying days between 8 and 22 July 2026 (8, 9, 10, 13, 16, 17, 18, 20, 22 Jul)
expectations.evidence: States 9 days (8-22 Jul) and splits them via task probes: 3 official training days (result_status 'practice') + 6 scored competition days (Tasks 1-6, 'official').

expectations.text: Airspace incursions are reported as zero AND the report explicitly notes that incursion analysis is disabled in the CPAS competition settings (incursions: false)
expectations.evidence: Zero incursions per day and per class, with the caveat 'a disabled detector is not evidence of a clean competition' and the terrain analogue.

expectations.text: Per-class handling is correct: the report either discovers the case-sensitive class names (Club, Standard) via the CPAS task endpoint and attributes days/events accordingly, or at minimum does not fabricate per-class event counts (encounter/incursion records carry no class labels)
expectations.evidence: Discovered Club and Standard via capitalised task probes (15 Metre/18 Metre/20 Metre Multi Seat/Open 404'd); attributed 20 Jul's 4 encounters to Club as 'probable, not certain' and flagged the Standard task-numbering jump 4->6 honestly. No fabricated per-class counts.

expectations.text: Proximity encounters (55 total, peaks on 13 Jul with 19 and 22 Jul with 21) are reported as distinct from airspace incursions, never conflated
expectations.evidence: 55 encounters clearly labelled 'not airspace violations', per-day line matching ground truth (19 on 13 Jul, 21 on 22 Jul), top CNs listed. Minor factual slip NOT covered by this assertion: claims no encounter carries a review tag, but the data holds 11 'Team' + 1 'Dubious' (agent sampled instead of counting; skill updated with a counting jq snippet).

expectations.text: A per-day weather summary is present covering the flown days (temperature, precipitation and/or wind), plus a narrative of the forecast evolution
expectations.evidence: Per-day weather columns plus a three-phase narrative correlated with climb ceilings, grid sizes and task lengths.

expectations.text: Total flights reported is 582 (or per-day counts 47/14/70/84/84/84/83/33/83)
expectations.evidence: 582 total flights in overview, text and daily-table Total row; per-day counts 47/14/70/84/84/84/83/33/83 match ground truth.
